001package com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.shop;
002
003import org.bukkit.entity.Player;
004import org.bukkit.plugin.Plugin;
005import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
006
007import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
008import java.util.LinkedList;
009
010/**
011 * Shop Control Manager and registry
012 */
013public interface ShopControlPanelManager {
014
015  /**
016   * Open ShopControlPanels for the player about specified shop
017   *
018   * @param player the player to open
019   * @param shop   the shop to open
020   */
021
022  void openControlPanel(@NotNull Player player, @NotNull Shop shop);
023
024  /**
025   * Retrieves a map of control components associated with the shop control panel manager.
026   *
027   * @return A map containing control components where the key is a string identifier and the value
028   * is a ControlComponent object.
029   */
030  LinkedHashMap<String, ControlComponent> controlComponents();
031
032  /**
033   * Retrieves a list of enabled components.
034   *
035   * @return A LinkedList containing string identifiers of the enabled components.
036   */
037  LinkedList<String> enabledComponents();
038
039  /**
040   * Adds the provided ControlComponent to the controlComponents map associated with the Shop
041   * Control Panel Manager.
042   *
043   * @param component The ControlComponent to add. Must not be null.
044   */
045  default void addComponent(@NotNull final ControlComponent component) {
046
047    controlComponents().put(component.identifier(), component);
048  }
049
050  /**
051   * Initializes the Shop Control Panel Manager and registers necessary components.
052   */
053  void initialize();
054
055  /**
056   * Register a {@link ShopControlPanel} to the manager
057   *
058   * @param panel the panel to register
059   */
060  void register(@NotNull ShopControlPanel panel);
061
062  /**
063   * Unregister all {@link ShopControlPanel} from the manager that registered by specified plugin
064   *
065   * @param plugin the plugin to unregister
066   */
067  void unregister(@NotNull Plugin plugin);
068
069  /**
070   * Unregister a {@link ShopControlPanel} from the manager
071   *
072   * @param panel the panel to unregister
073   */
074
075  void unregister(@NotNull ShopControlPanel panel);
076}
